title: Construction of Gabion wall for protection of LH tower and premises at Kovilthottam Lighthouse
summary: E-tender to build a gabion wall protecting the lighthouse tower and premises at Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Kollam district, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin; a corrigendum extended the bid dates.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Kovilthottam, District Kollam, Kerala - 691583
sites.work: Construction of gabion wall for protection of lighthouse tower and premises

scope.item: Construction of Gabion wall for protection of LH tower and premises

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by post/hand. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate
Similar work: construction of sea protection work by groins/gabion wall/tetrapod etc.
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified annual turnover of last three years
Bidders with near relatives posted as Accountant or Junior Engineer or higher in DGLL not permitted
specs: Gabion wall (sea protection) for lighthouse tower and premises

corrigenda.change: Corrigendum-I: bid submission extended from 26.09.2024 to 08.10.2024 15:00; EMD/technical documents (original) from 25.09.2024 to 07.10.2024 15:00; technical bid opening from 27.09.2024 to 09.10.2024 15:00. Other terms unchanged. Corrigendum names the work as gabion wall construction and protection work for lighthouse tower, power house (Hindi).

notes: Section-I NIT only; no BOQ. Original schedule: download/submission 06.09.2024 10:00 to 26.09.2024 15:00, query last date 11.09.2024, pre-bid 12.09.2024, EMD by 25.09.2024, opening 27.09.2024; dates field reflects corrigendum. Technical opening subject to internet availability.
